measures.what: spacing between the two holes on the same mounting tab (and whether that's center-to-center or inside-edge to inside-edge)
measures.reply: servo tab holes: 4.58 mm (each mounting tab has two holes, open to the tab's end like a U); servo hole spacing: 44.61 mm (between the holes on the two tabs, from the inside edge of one to the inside edge of the other; I didn't measure the spacing between the two holes on one tab)

measures.what: overall length across the mounting tabs from outer tip to outer tip, and whether the bottom face of the tabs is flat or also has a rib
measures.reply: servo body length: 40.58 mm (the case, end to end, not counting the tabs); servo rib width: 1.51 mm (a rib on each tab's top face (the shaft side), between the tab's two holes; it stops the tabs sitting flush); servo rib height: 1.8 mm (how far the rib stands up from the tab's top face); servo rib position: 8.31 mm (from the side of the holes to the middle of the rib)

measures.what: cable exit strain relief: width, height, how far it sticks out from the end of the case, and how far below the bottom of the mounting tabs it starts
measures.reply: servo body width: 19.82 mm (the case, side to side); servo body height: 40.4 mm (the case, top to bottom); servo rib width: 1.51 mm (a rib on each tab's top face (the shaft side), between the tab's two holes; it stops the tabs sitting flush); servo rib height: 1.8 mm (how far the rib stands up from the tab's top face); servo rib position: 8.31 mm (from the side of the holes to the middle of the rib); servo cable exit: out of one end of the case, below the tabs (where the cable leaves; I didn't measure its size or how far it sticks out)
